profile.text: Pramanix is a Karlan Saintess born in Kjerag, the leader of the entire religion of her homeland. She uses the holy bell given to her by the gods to summon the power of wind and snow. She came to Rhodes Island by secret means, and the post she holds as well as how long she's held it are both confidential.
